from datetime import datetime

# Retrieve cached flight results
cached_flights = get_results_from_cache(key="filtered_flights")

# Calculate check-in and check-out dates for the hotel
# User is traveling on May 17, 2025, and we need to determine the stay duration
# Since the user didn't specify the number of nights, we'll assume a typical 3-night stay
# Check-in: May 17, 2025
# Check-out: May 20, 2025 (3 nights)
checkin_date = ["May 17, 2025"]
checkout_date = ["May 20, 2025"]

# Search for hotels in Colorado Springs near Downtown with 3-star rating
hotels = search_hotels(
    city="Colorado Springs",
    checkin_date=checkin_date,
    checkout_date=checkout_date,
    neighborhood=["Downtown"],
    stars=[3, 3]
)

# Save hotel results to cache
save_to_cache(key="hotels", value=hotels)

# Search for restaurants in Colorado Springs with Turkish or Persian cuisine
restaurants = search_restaurants(
    city="Colorado Springs",
    cuisine=["Turkish", "Persian"]
)

# Save restaurant results to cache
save_to_cache(key="restaurants", value=restaurants)

# Find the nearest hotels and restaurants to the attractions (if any)
# Since no attractions were searched, we'll just group by hotel
nearest = search_nearest(
    hotels=hotels,
    restaurants=restaurants,
    groupBy="hotel"
)

# Save nearest results to cache
save_to_cache(key="nearest", value=nearest)

print("Travel planning completed for flights, hotels, and restaurants.")
